import math
def kmeans_step(points, centroids):
    """Performs a single k-means iteration."""
    clusters = [[] for _ in centroids]
    for p in points:
        distances = [math.dist(p, c) for c in centroids]
        clusters[distances.index(min(distances))].append(p)
    return [tuple(round(sum(dim) / len(c), 2) for dim in zip(*c)) if c else centroids[i] for i, c in enumerate(clusters)]
def kmeans(points, centroids):
    """Runs k-means until convergence or 20 iterations."""
    for _ in range(20):
        new_centroids = kmeans_step(points, centroids)
        if new_centroids == centroids: break
        centroids = new_centroids
    return centroids
print(kmeans_step([(1, 1), (2, 1), (8, 8), (9, 8)], [(1, 1), (9, 8)]))
